'''2000 Australasian Continental Championship Death Star II Sealed''' was a Star Wars CCG sealed held in Sydney, Australia on 15 July 2000. It is known from Michael Josem's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1013">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-16-asia-pacific-championships-sydney-16-7d1013/ asia-pacific-championships-sydney-16-7], DeckTech (Michael "Joz" Josem, 16 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-16-asia-pacific-championships-sydney-16-7d1013/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[2000 Australasian Continental Championship]].

* '''Date:''' 15 July 2000
* '''Site:''' Sydney, Australia
* '''Format:''' [[Sealed Deck]]
